Entry runs as a per-node provenance bond: weight vests only after a candidate passes a probe and can forge a receipt. One audit workload crosses the relay bridge to the ledger; an auditor on an isolated mesa signs the receipt.

Probes are drawn per candidate; each receipt embeds the key and a fresh nonce, so none pool. Honest agents forge one receipt and pay once.

A sybil operator pays per puppet: each fake identity runs its own probe, real compute and one signature, no bulk discount. N sybils cost N probes plus N forfeitable bonds.
